public_prompt: A batch job's credential leaked into a log and was later used to delete production data in a region the job never touches. The reading so far: the credential was valid for too long, so rotate it every 24 hours and the exposure closes. Diagnose the defect and specify the fix.
observable_resources: batch/role.json — the job's credential is attached to a role holding wildcard permission on every resource in the account
batch/audit-trail.csv — the job itself touches 3 buckets and 1 table; the leaked credential was used against 41 resources
batch/rotation-note.md — rotates every 24 hours; in the incident the interval between the leak and the misuse was 90 minutes
batch/provider-docs.md — the provider can issue a short-lived credential restricted to a named resource list and a named action list
closure:incident-2026-02-remediation — closed; schedules rotation and closes the incident
closure:job-log-retention — closed; keeps job logs for 90 days; rests on the records policy, not on what the job's credential may reach

protected_gold.root_success_rubric: PASS iff the specified fix issues the job a credential restricted to the 3 buckets and 1 table it touches and to the actions it performs, and the answer states that rotation does not reduce what a leaked credential can reach inside its validity window — the incident's 90 minutes sitting well inside 24 hours. FAIL if the fix is rotation, a shorter rotation period, log redaction, or alerting on unusual use.

source_provenance: no external dataset; every figure is authored for this benchmark and is not an empirical finding
notes: A solver that keeps the lifetime framing schedules rotation; the 90-minute leak-to-use interval means every future leak still reaches all 41 resources.
